children: Lim Kien Leong disclosed control of all 500,000 Class B shares of Cheer Holding, Inc., equal to a 100% stake in that class. The shares transferred to his Hong Kong vehicle, Lioness Limited, on September 22, 2026. Because each Class B share carries 100 votes, this stake gives about 96.44% of Cheer Holding’s total voting power.

Lim Kien Leong acquired the Class B shares "for investment purposes and to obtain voting control of the Issuer." He plans to review the position over time and may talk with Cheer Holding’s management, board, and shareholders about strategy, governance, and capital decisions.

The filing notes no immediate board or management changes, and Bing Zhang remains chairman, CEO, and interim CFO. The investors also state they "intend to review their investment on a continuing basis," and could buy more securities or sell holdings as they reassess their plans.

Lioness Limited is a Hong Kong investment company wholly owned by Lim Kien Leong. Lim Kien Leong is a Singaporean investor who controls Lioness and directs its investment decisions. He often uses structured positions, including special share classes, to secure governance influence when opportunities arise.
